scope: Independent source read and offline CPU counterexamples; no real-window acceptance and no human signature.

read_review.source_and_fresh: Original source consistency is checked before anonymous mapping; current explicit ID is checked by adapter before dispatch. No conflicting native ID is silently changed to the text target.
read_review.anonymous_ocr: Positive-area overlapping readable OCR must be one complete matching label or existing word-run ID set. Mixed controls and duplicate same-name labels inside a large contour are rejected. No local OCR/low-confidence/nonoverlapping labels do not invent a conflict.
read_review.duplicate_and_unknown: ID-only and consistent explicit ID among repeated labels remain supported. Unknown OCR is not promoted to semantic proof.
read_review.native_prompt: Generic future native-output guidance prefers text-only for unique visible OCR, consistent ID for repeated labels; it does not patch a returned native plan or add budget.
read_review.telemetry: Detached flat status copy after both persisted records. Ordinary observer Exception is isolated with fixed diagnostic. KeyboardInterrupt/SystemExit propagate into normal cancellation.
read_review.offsets: Factory and relay bind per-child goal and actions/planning offsets. Root telemetry stays executing with child stage detail and monotonic count high-water marks; completed credit comes only from verified outer ledger.
read_review.clock: Root RunMonitor now uses its default independent monotonic clock; execution deadline clock is unchanged. No model/budget authority is derived from status.
read_review.cancel_journal: Before input known0/unknown0; returned but not journaled receipt known0/unknown1; after journal known1/unknown0. Each actual attempt count remains conserved, cancelled, no replay and no final rescue.
read_review.http: A locally denied planning call can be counted without an HTTP request; tested cap case is planning3/actualHTTP2, zero task inputs.

limitations: Text/ID consistency does not prove widget role, arbitrary instruction meaning or global GUI safety.
Fresh-case pixel mapping and foreground checking are explicit CPU doubles; no pixel-grounding or live-window success is claimed.
Current matching and negation limitations are not repaired by this guard.
Live acceptance, native instruction versus independent operation events, source freeze and final regression remain Root prerequisites.

metadata_helper_first_attempt.assertion_issue: Expected method label _retry_plan; actual changed recovery method is _prepare_recovery. Corrected only the private metadata assertion after reading AST.
